company: Agrawal's 420 group, Indore (est. 1962). Namkeen is sold as 'Agrawal's 420 Namkeen' and made by Agrawal Snacks Food India LLP (Limbodagari, Hatod, Indore; catalogue site 420namkeen.in). Papad/instant mixes are made by Agrawal Papad Pvt. Ltd. (374 Hukumchand Colony, Panchkuiya Road, Indore; 420papad.com).
notes: officialSite is the group's own online store (linked from 420papad.com) and has Namkeen, Bakery, Sweets, Papad and Instant Mix sections. agrawal420.com is a parked domain, not the brand. All MRPs are the official store's selling prices; the store doesn't label them 'MRP'. 400 g price = 200 g price + Rs 57 option surcharge, and 900 g = + Rs 200. Mirchi.com sells 400 g packs at Rs 145 (Rs 141 after discount), shipping included, so we didn't use those prices. Logo is only 150x150 px. Several images come from Mirchi.com, a marketplace whose listings say the goods ship directly from 'Agrawal's 420 Bites, Indore'.

company: Mahendra Ke Namkeen, 63 Malganj Chouraha, Jawahar Marg, Indore 452002 (MP). The pack reads 'Mahendra Ke Namkeen'.
notes: Identified from the pack wordmark 'MAHENDRA KE NAMKEEN', which matches the official site. Indore has other similarly named, unrelated firms in directories (e.g. 'Mahendra Namkeen', Old Palasia; 'Mahendra Sev Bhandar', Malharganj). Confirm with your distributor that you stock Mahendra Ke Namkeen. MRPs are the per-pack prices on the official site, which doesn't label them 'MRP'. The site also shows 'Minimum order quantity - 5 Kg', template '-90%' badges and lorem-ipsum text, so treat its prices as indicative. Every variant comes in the same red pouch. The official site only has bowl photos, so most pack shots come from TheDesiFood.com, an export reseller whose USD prices we ignored. Each variant there is identified only by the reseller's label. Logo is 270x69 px.
